exceptions.reason: This is the CD-5 walker's own test suite: proving the walker flags bare `// TODO` / `// biome-ignore` / `// @ts-expect-error` annotations requires naming those exact literals in test titles and rule-string assertions, so the per-line matcher fires on the assertions themselves. A test of the annotation rule cannot avoid writing the annotations. The deliberately-violating fixture files it exercises live under test-fixtures/, which is scope-excluded; this entry covers only the assertion strings in the test body.

Structural CD19 location: defaultPathOperations/pathOperationsFor confines Node path and file-URL conversion behind named string-only PathOperations. Reviewer consumers use this existing adapter; no platform types are exported. The additional module-location capability is a deliberate reviewer-port paydown boundary decision.

Structural CD19 location: defaultSidecarFileReader/defaultFileKindPort/defaultFileTextPort confines filesystem and temporary-directory runtime access. Review scripts and hermetic fixtures consume named text/file capabilities with production factories; no Node file/stat types are exported. Adding writes and temporary scratch lifecycle here reuses the existing filesystem boundary instead of opening a second Node fs wrapping site.

Structural CD19 location: defaultReviewProcessPort is the deliberate process boundary for reviewer entrypoints and hermetic subprocess fixtures. It confines Node child execution, environment, standard streams and termination; consumers receive string/status data and named capabilities, never ChildProcess or stream types.

Structural CD19 location: defaultContentDigestPort confines node:crypto sha256 hashing behind a ContentDigestPort whose single capability takes text or bytes and returns a hex string. Consumers receive the digest string, never a Hash object. This is the single wrapping site for content hashing in the rin plugin's tools.
